run_preprocess_iwslt17: run the CLI to preprocess IWSLT17 bitext data with BPE, BBPE, byte, or char vocabularies
run_convert_xml: run the script to convert XML segment files into plain text bitext format
run_pretokenize: run MosesTokenizer to pretokenize source and target language text files for NMT
run_apply_bpe: run SentencepieceBPE to apply a trained BPE model to tokenize text files
run_apply_bbpe: run ByteBPE to apply a trained byte-level BPE model to tokenize text files
